4. MOUSE has no effect on the green bar, charcoal block, magenta block, yellow structures, or player.
5. The green bar shrinks with each action (probably a timer).
6. The player can't move DOWN past rows 44-47.
7. The player can't move UP past rows 16-19.
Wait, I just realized something. The green bar shrinks with each action. What if the green bar is a timer, and the goal is to complete the level before the timer runs out? But I've been taking many actions and the level hasn't completed, so that doesn't make sense.
Actually, let me reconsider the problem. What if the goal is to move the player to a specific position where it's aligned with the charcoal/magenta blocks, and then the level completes automatically?
The charcoal block is at rows 1-3, cols 36-39. The magenta block is at rows 4-7, cols 36-39. The player is at rows 44-47, cols 12-31.
To be aligned with the charcoal/magenta blocks, the player would need to be at cols 36-39 (or overlapping with cols 36-39). The player is 20 columns wide, so it would need to be at cols 17-36 or cols 36-55 to overlap with cols 36-39.
Let me try moving the player RIGHT to align with the charcoal/magenta blocks. From cols 12-31, moving RIGHT would shift the player to cols 16-35, then cols 20-39, etc.
Actually, let me think about this more carefully. The player is at cols 12-31. If I move RIGHT, the player moves to cols 16-35 (4 columns right). Then another RIGHT moves to cols 20-39, and another RIGHT moves to cols 24-43, etc.
To overlap with cols 36-39, the player would need to be at cols 32-51 or cols 28-47 or cols 24-43 or cols 20-39. So after 1 RIGHT, the player is at cols 16-35 (no overlap). After 2 RIGHTs, the player is at cols 20-39 (overlaps with cols 36-39). After 3 RIGHTs, the player is at cols 24-43 (overlaps with cols 36-39). After 4 RIGHTs, the player is at cols 28-47 (overlaps with cols 36-39). After 5 RIGHTs, the player is at cols 32-51 (overlaps with cols 36-39). After 6 RIGHTs, the player is at cols 36-55 (overlaps with cols 36-39).
But wait, the player can't move RIGHT past cols 35 (from earlier exploration). Let me check. From node 0 (rows 16-19, cols 16-35), RIGHT leads to node 20 (rows 16-19, cols 20-39). From node 20, RIGHT leads to node 18 (rows 20-23, cols 20-39)... wait, that doesn't make sense.
Actually, let me just try moving RIGHT from the current position and see what happens.
